room_fire_walkandbranch.note: Reconstructed layout: this room is missing from the decompiled project. Connections, NPC and genocide forcefield position are taken from the game code that references room 159.

roomBackgroundNotes: The decompiler dropped room background layers (or repeated the second layer's name). These are restored by matching unused background images to rooms by size and wall layout. The stairwell layer in both houses was exported as tiled and scrolling (vspeed 1); it is placed once, filling the stairwell opening.
pathNotes: Path data is missing from the decompiled project. These are reconstructed from room layouts and the scripts that use them; they are approximations.
faceSpritesNote: The face objects pick their sprite with bare numbers (real(N)) that the decompiler could not name. The sprite at each number is chosen by matching every emotion code against the dialogue lines that use it.

spriteIndexFixesNote: Bare sprite numbers whose index map entry was a guess. Each index is set to the named sprite (the names swap places), so every use of that number agrees.
frameOffsetsNote: Hand-checked frame positions where the automatic trim recovery guesses wrong. Grillby behind the counter is lined up with his walking sprite so he stands behind the bar.
invisibleObjectsNote: Cutscene triggers that use the blue editor marker sprite but were exported as visible. Drawn, they show as a tall blue bar (obj_undyne1 is stretched 999 times).
rectMaskNote: Collision type was lost in export. These use a rectangle, as do outline-drawn editor boxes (walls, doors, markers, triggers) used only by invisible objects. Slopes and other solid shapes stay precise.
soundIndexFixesNote: Sound numbers the index table had guessed. Taken from scr_getmusindex, which pairs every music file path with its sound number.
